description: Submit an AI tool for the list. Free listings wait for review. For fasttrack and featured you get checkoutUrl: give it to the person, who pays on Stripe.

email.description: The maker's email, for questions about the listing. Never shown.

launchAt.description: Only for a tool that isn't out yet: its launch day (UTC), YYYY-MM-DD, up to six months ahead. It shows as upcoming until then.

logoUrl.description: A link to the tool's logo (square PNG, SVG or JPEG). Without it we take the icon from the tool's site.

sharedPaymentToken.description: Pay by card now, as the agent: a Stripe shared payment token (spt_...) granted to our seller profile (see get_plans) for at least the plan price in USD. Charged once; without it, paid plans return a checkoutUrl for a person.

tagline.description: One line about the tool, no links

name: submit_listing
title: List an AI tool
